name: Mission Trails dirt lot by the Visitor Center, Father Junipero Serra Trail
basis: Mountain Project Mission Gorge 'Getting There': turn into Mission Trails Regional Park on Father Junipero Serra Trail, 'Park along the road prior to the gates, or in the dirt parking lots next to the visitors center'; climbers loop trails are on the right side marked by kiosks. Allied Climbers of San Diego: 'Park along the road or at the visitor's center'; the climbers loop trail is on the right down Father Junipero Serra Trail. Same access for all sectors. Named-place check: the Visitor and Interpretive Center building maps at 32.82023,-117.05681; this lot is 0.12 km from it (the other nearby lot w615764371, cap 10, is 0.19 km). Road check: lot sits 0.09 km from Father Junipero Serra Trail near its southern end, by the Visitor Center Loop Trail trailheads. Match by position, medium.
